name: Mid India Industries Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1991, Mid India Industries Ltd is in the business of Real Estate and Trading activities.[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1][2]
MIIL used to be in the textile business with expertise in spinning, cotton ginning, and related textile industries. Currently, it is engaged in trading activities in plant and machinery. It is looking for an opportunity to import and export the plant and machinery required for industries, etc. The company also deals in real estate development.

cons: The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -5.69% over past five years.
